 Rhodes & Young Injury Lawyers
 Katy, TX
 Phone 346-555-3597
 Letter of Representation
8 Jun 2025
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1445
Our client: Steven Chavez
Date of loss: 31 May 2025
Dear Claims Representative:
We have been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred while our
client was changing lanes and was sideswiped by another vehicle. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this
incident and is currently under medical care.
Please direct all future communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly,
whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Any statements, requests for information, or settlement discussions should
be routed through our firm.
We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy issued to your insured,
along with a certified copy of the declarations page, within thirty days of receipt of this letter.
We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, dash camera or
telematics data, recorded statements, the claim file, adjuster notes, repair estimates, vehicle inspection reports, and
any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or
repaired without prior notice to this office.
Sincerely,
Patrick Rose
Rhodes & Young Injury Lawyers
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
